<!doctype html>
<html lang="zh-CN">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<title>OpenDesk Browser · 基础网页交互测试</title>
<style>
:root{font:14px/1.55 -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"PingFang SC","Microsoft YaHei",system-ui,sans-serif;color:#19283d;background:#f7f9fc;font-synthesis:none}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
body{margin:0}
button,input,select{font:inherit}
button{min-height:38px;cursor:pointer;border:1px solid #cbd5e1;border-radius:8px;padding:7px 13px;font-weight:600;color:#253854;background:#fff}
button:hover{background:#f0f4fa}
button:disabled{opacity:.52;cursor:not-allowed}
button.primary{color:#fff;border-color:#2855bd;background:#2855bd}
button.primary:hover{background:#2048a5}
button.text-button{border:0;background:transparent;color:#51637c;padding-inline:7px}
:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #86a7ef;outline-offset:2px}
.topbar{background:white;border-bottom:1px solid #e0e6ee}
.topbar-inner{max-width:760px;min-height:56px;margin:auto;padding:9px 22px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px}
.brand{display:flex;gap:9px;align-items:center;font-size:14px;font-weight:760}
.brand-mark{width:27px;height:27px;display:grid;place-items:center;color:#fff;background:#2855bd;border-radius:8px;font-size:15px}
.brand-note{font-size:12px;color:#596a82;font-weight:400}
main{max-width:760px;margin:27px auto 48px;padding:0 22px}
h1{font-size:24px;letter-spacing:-.03em;line-height:1.3;margin:0 0 5px}
.intro{margin:0 0 17px;color:#63748a;font-size:13px}
.sheet{background:#fff;border:1px solid #e0e6ee;border-radius:12px;box-shadow:0 4px 18px #1b355108;overflow:hidden}
.unit{padding:18px 22px 20px;min-width:0}
.unit+.unit{border-top:1px solid #e8edf4}
.unit-heading{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;margin-bottom:10px}
.unit-heading small{font-weight:750;color:#64748b;font-size:11px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
h2{margin:0;font-size:14px;letter-spacing:-.01em;color:#203650}
h3{margin:4px 0;font-size:18px;letter-spacing:-.025em}
.sample-text{margin:0;color:#52647c}
.chips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;list-style:none;margin:12px 0 0;padding:0}
.chips li{padding:3px 9px;background:#f3f6fa;border:1px solid #e7edf3;border-radius:6px;color:#5a6c83;font-size:12px}
.controls{display:flex;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px}
.result-line{margin:10px 0 0;font-size:13px;color:#516681}
.result-line output{font-weight:800;color:#2855bd;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.expanded{margin:10px 0 0;padding:10px 12px;border-radius:8px;background:#f3f7fc;color:#344d72;font-size:13px}
label{font-size:12px;color:#445974;font-weight:650}
select,input{min-height:38px;min-width:0;color:#20324b;background:#fff;border:1px solid #cbd5e1;border-radius:8px;padding:7px 10px}
#delay{width:118px}
.status{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;color:#61738b;margin-top:12px;font-size:13px}
.indicator{width:7px;height:7px;flex:none;border-radius:50%;background:#a5b1c1}
.status[data-state="loading"] .indicator{background:#ca9137}
.status[data-state="success"] .indicator{background:#198767}
.status[data-state="error"] .indicator,.status[data-state="timeout"] .indicator{background:#c24953}
#async-result{margin:6px 0 0;color:#176546;font-size:13px}
#async-result:empty{display:none}
#async-error{color:#a83f4b}
.fields{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:flex-end;gap:9px}
.field{display:grid;gap:5px;flex:1;min-width:165px}
.field input,.field select{width:100%}
.feedback{margin:12px 0 0}
#done{display:inline-block;margin:0;padding:8px 11px;border-radius:8px;background:#ecf8f0;color:#1b693c;font-weight:700}
#form-hint{color:#b63a47;font-size:12px;margin:6px 0 0}
#form-hint:empty,#form-result:empty{display:none}
#search-form{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:flex-end;gap:10px}
#search-status{font-size:13px;color:#176546;margin:10px 0 0}
#results{font-size:13px;color:#344d70;margin-top:5px}
#search-count{font-size:12px;color:#61728a;margin:6px 0 0}
.footnote{font-size:12px;color:#5c6e85;margin:12px 0 0}
.api-url-field{flex-basis:100%}
